About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.


Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.


In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.


Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.


School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.

Diferenciar a instrução utilizando os princípios do Universal Design for Learning (UDL), atendendo às necessidades de estudantes com diferentes perfis de aprendizagem. Implementar, documentar e aprimorar continuamente unidades curriculares utilizando a metodologia Understanding by Design (UbD). Avaliar a aprendizagem dos alunos por meio de avaliações diagnósticas, formativas e somativas, utilizando dados para orientar o ensino e fornecer feedback significativo. Promover um ambiente de sala de aula seguro, inclusivo e centrado no aluno, favorecendo autonomia, pertencimento e crescimento acadêmico. Colaborar com colegas, especialistas de Suporte à Aprendizagem e famílias para apoiar o sucesso dos estudantes. Integrar tecnologia, ferramentas de inteligência artificial, valores morais e perspectivas globais ao processo de ensino e aprendizagem. 


Requisitos: Graduação em Pedagogia. Fluência em inglês (português é desejável). Experiência docente, preferencialmente em contextos bilíngues ou internacionais. Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz com estudantes de diferentes origens culturais. Experiência com o Programa de Anos Iniciais do International Baccalaureate (IB PYP) ou disponibilidade para participar dos treinamentos. Sólidas habilidades de planejamento curricular, avaliação da aprendizagem e gestão de sala de aula. Capacidade de criar experiências de aprendizagem envolventes, desafiadoras e inclusivas. Compromisso com a ética profissional, o desenvolvimento contínuo e o trabalho colaborativo em uma comunidade internacional diversa.


Sobre a empresa: A Escola das Nações é uma instituição internacional, privada, sem fins lucrativos, coeducacional e duolinguística (inglês e português), localizada em Brasília. Oferecemos um programa educacional que vai do berçário ao 12º ano e somos credenciados internacionalmente pela NEASC e, nacionalmente, pela Secretaria de Educação do Distrito Federal. Com estudantes e colaboradores de 30 países e origens diversas, promovemos um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo que incentiva a cidadania global e valoriza a diversidade.


Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.


Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.


A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.


A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Electrical Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

You have built solid experience in high-voltage engineering and you are ready to take full technical ownership of primary system design on projects that sit at the heart of the energy transition. If working on complex HV infrastructure for a technically leading organisation in Europe interests you, this role is worth your full attention.


Company Information

Our client is a recognised leader in the design, implementation, and management of high-voltage systems in the Netherlands. With a strong focus on innovation and sustainable energy strategy, they work at the forefront of grid enhancement and energy transition projects across the sector. Their engineering teams bring deep technical expertise to primary HV systems and the civil and structural solutions required to support them. This is a technically driven organisation where quality, precision, and engineering integrity are central to everything they deliver.


Vacancy Information

As an Electrical Engineer, your focus sits firmly in the domain of high-voltage primary systems and the supporting structures required for the installation and mounting of HV components. This includes power transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, current and voltage instrument transformers, cable and overhead line connections, and all associated civil and structural support arrangements.

You will take full responsibility from basic design through detailed design and on to execution and project delivery. You will translate functional requirements into concrete technical solutions, prepare and review engineering documentation, and support the Lead Engineer and Technical Manager across all project phases. When design bottlenecks arise, you identify and resolve them. When quality checks are needed, you perform them.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership and direct involvement from the earliest design stages through to final delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Translating functional designs and client requirements into concrete technical designs and project plans for HV primary systems.
  • Designing and verifying integrated solutions based on client specifications, applicable technical standards including IEC and ABNT, and relevant laws and regulations.
  • Preparing and reviewing technical documentation, engineering drawings, calculations, and execution documents across all project phases.
  • Supporting the Lead Engineer and Technical Manager from basic design in the preparation phase through to detailed execution design.
  • Identifying and resolving design bottlenecks, reporting findings to the wider project team, and performing quality checks on deliverables.
  • Working closely with civil, structural, and electrical disciplines to ensure that primary component installations are fully integrated and constructible.


What You Need

  • Bachelor degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Power Engineering, or a comparable technical field.
  • Solid experience in high-voltage primary system design, with working knowledge of HV components such as power transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, and instrument transformers including CTs and VTs.
  • Familiarity with HV substation layouts, overhead line connections, cable termination arrangements, and supporting civil and structural requirements.
  • Understanding of applicable technical standards and design codes relevant to high-voltage systems including IEC standards. Familiarity with ABNT NBR requirements is considered an advantage.
  • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to develop and verify integrated technical solutions under project conditions.
  • A proactive and results-oriented mindset with the drive to deliver quality outcomes for both the project and your own professional development.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Willingness to learn Dutch and integrate into a Dutch working environment is expected and will be an important part of settling into the team successfully.


If you do not meet every requirement but have a strong background in high-voltage engineering and a genuine interest in primary system design, we still encourage you to apply. The right combination of technical experience, motivation, and willingness to grow can make you a strong candidate.


Relocation

This position is based in the Netherlands and will require relocation. We understand that making an international move is a significant decision and we are here to make that process as straightforward as possible.

As part of your contract, FairPlay Engineering provides a Premium Relocation Package. This includes visa sponsorship, guidance before your move, and dedicated support from a relocation consultant throughout the process. You can find more information on the Relocating with us page on our website.


Apply

We appreciate every application we receive. Because this is a specialised role, we will contact candidates whose experience closely matches the requirements.

If you have not heard from us within two weeks, your application has unfortunately not been selected for the next step.


FairPlay Engineering specialises in recruiting engineers for roles in the Netherlands. If this vacancy is not the right match for you, keep an eye on our vacancies page for future opportunities.

This position is critical to ensuring sustained commercial performance in Minas Gerais and Goiás region, which represents the highest number of distributor and is nationally known as the “Wholesales Headquarters”; this region is the frontier of the 2 high density areas (Southeast and Northeast). The territory covered concentrates a significant portion of national demand. This area is essential to Envu to keep and increase our capillarity.


YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:


This role directly supports execution of the business strategy and is responsible for driving:

  • Sustained revenue growth in the highest-value region in Brazil;
  • Expansion of market share in high-density urban areas;
  • Development of strategic distributor;
  • Strengthening demand generation initiatives and pipeline robustness;
  • Mitigating competitive pressure in the most contested marketplace.
  • Deliver AOP and Financial Targets: Lead business management with partners building and monitoring sell-out campaigns, goals plan, inventory and order management, credit and collection alignment, financial tools, action plan and distributor growth in the medium/long term.
  • Accelerate Business Growth. Expanding market penetration drives new business opportunities.
  • Strengthen Channels: Builds strategic distributor partnerships and increases end-user exposure to maximize portfolio reach.


ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?


Main requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Veterinary Medicine, or Animal Science (Zootechny) required;
  • Relevant experience in commercial roles within agriculture, animal health, or related industries;
  • English Intermediate level required;
  • Willingness to travel frequently;
  • Proven experience working with distributors and/or wholesalers;
  • Solid background in multinational companies;
  • Strong analytical capability, including ability to manage and interpret sell-in and sell-out data;
  • Experience in commercial campaign development and execution;
  • Solid understanding of distribution and channel management (B2B indirect sales model);
  • Results-oriented profile with resilience;
  • Strong ability to work in a dynamic and flexible sales environment;
  • Balanced profile between strategic thinking and operational execution;
  • Commercial experience with urban pest control products.

  • Comunicação Interpessoal: Habilidade para influenciar stakeholders executivos e orientar times técnicos.
  • Domínio de Ambientes Híbridos: Experiência comprovada na integração de ambientes On-premises com soluções Cloud.
  • Frameworks e Metodologias: Conhecimento sólido em TOGAF e experiência com modelos Hub-and-Spoke/Sandbox.
  • Especialista em Cloud (GCP): Domínio de BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer e AlloyDB.
  • Multi-Cloud e Bancos de Dados: Vivência com AWS, OCI e Bancos Oracle CDB/PDB, MongoDB e AlloyDB, CloudSQl, BigTable.



Serão diferenciais para a vaga

title: Tech Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!


Somos uma aceleradora de soluções digitais e buscamos Tech Lead para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Líder Técnico (LT) é fundamental para o desenho e a implementação de melhores práticas no desenvolvimento de software, sempre pautado em metodologias ágeis. Dentro do Dev Team, o LT atua ativamente nas cerimônias ágeis, no refinamento, na análise de impacto e no desenho dos itens do Backlog do produto.


• Liderança Técnica: Atuar como líder técnico para os desenvolvedores, orientando e apoiando o time no dia a dia.

• Melhores Práticas e Qualidade: Desenhar e promover um conjunto de melhores práticas para o desenvolvimento de software utilizando métodos ágeis.

• Refinamento e Análise: Participar ativamente do refinamento, análise de impacto e desenho dos itens do Backlog do produto.

• Discovery e Hipóteses de Negócio: Contribuir ativamente nas sessões de Discovery, oferecendo insights sobre as hipóteses de negócio sob a perspectiva de práticas de desenvolvimento e construção de aplicações.

• Direção Técnica: Ajudar a definir a direção técnica do produto, garantindo a evolução e a qualidade do desenvolvimento.

• Comunicação e Alinhamento: Garantir a comunicação clara entre as definições de arquitetura e os componentes de software.

• Padrões e Normas: Assegurar o atendimento aos padrões de desenvolvimento de software da Porto, incluindo desenvolvimento seguro e demais normas aplicáveis à tecnologia utilizada pela Squad.

• Otimização de Processos: Propor processos e ferramentas que facilitem o dia a dia da Squad.

• Promoção de Ritos Técnicos: Promover entre os Desenvolvedores a adoção de processos e ritos técnicos como estimativas, definições técnicas, gitflow e mapeamento de débitos técnicos.

• Qualidade do Código: Ser responsável pela qualidade do código desenvolvido, adequação aos critérios de aceite, manutenção e melhoria contínua.

• Alinhamento Estratégico: Seguir os direcionamentos das disciplinas de Arquitetura, Tech Leads, Segurança da Informação e demais disciplinas relacionadas à Engenharia de Software.


Requisitos e qualificações

• Formação: Superior completo ou cursando na área de Tecnologia.

• Metodologias Ágeis e DevOps: Conhecimento e experiência comprovada em equipes com metodologias ágeis e práticas de DevOps.

• Linguagens de Programação: Conhecimento sólido em linguagens como Java, Python, jQuery, JavaScript, HTML, Angular e PL-SQL.

• Cloud: Conhecimento em plataformas Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP).

• Arquitetura de Software: Conhecimento em arquitetura de software, incluindo princípios SOLID, DDD (Domain-Driven Design) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

• Microsserviços: Conhecimento em arquitetura de Microsserviços.

• Containers: Experiência com Containers e Orquestração de Containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Experiência com Chatbots: Experiência em linguagens de programação relevantes para o entendimento do código subjacente de chatbots, facilitando ajustes e colaboração com o time de desenvolvimento.


Informações adicionais


Aqui nós somos humanos, somos digitais, somos Verity!


Tudo o que fazemos se baseia em nossos 8 POWER PRINCIPLES:

  • Amar tecnologia;
  • Assumir grandes responsabilidades;
  • Cultivar relações de confiança por meio da transparência;
  • Dar atenção e ser orientado pela necessidade e experiência do cliente;
  • Encarar desafios de forma ágil;
  • Colaborar entre pessoas e equipes;
  • Encorajar a autonomia consciente;
  • Atingir resultados de forma consciente.


É assim que criamos experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital, inspirando protagonismo e gerando resultados incríveis aos nossos clientes, sempre focados em metodologia, tecnologia e pessoas.


Fomos certificados como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar pelo Great Place To Work, e a cada dia criamos ações que melhoram ainda mais o ambiente de trabalho, aqui na Verity você tem:

  • Vale refeição
  • Vale alimentação
  • Auxílio home office
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Parcerias de descontos
  • Convênios em estabelecimentos e instituições de ensino
  • Treinamentos de agilidade recorrentes
  • Verity Learning
  • Intervalo Verity
  • #VerityComVocê


E aí, topa criar experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital?


Etapas do processo

  • Etapa 1: Cadastro
  • Etapa 2: Entrevista RH
  • Etapa 3: Entrevista Tech
  • Etapa 4: Entrevista Final
  • Etapa 5: Processo de Contratação
  • Etapa 6: Contratação


Somos uma consultoria de Transformação e Engenharia Digital


A Verity é uma consultoria de Transformação e Engenharia Digital.


Estruturamos tecnologia para funcionar, escalar e gerar valor real. Atuamos na Modernização de Aplicações, decisões críticas de Arquitetura, Engenharia de Software e Dados, Experiência Digital e orquestração de processos com Inteligência Artificial.


Com o Verity Quantum®, nosso orquestrador de IA, conectamos engenharia, plataformas e operações para modernizar legados, otimizar código e acelerar decisões com impacto direto no negócio.


Há 16 anos, trabalhamos ao lado de mais de 100 empresas líderes em seus mercados, nos setores financeiro, saúde, varejo, indústria e serviços, transformando estratégia em soluções tecnológicas que geram eficiência, escala e vantagem competitiva.

title: Key Account Manager Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Key Account Manager Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We’re Hiring!


Key Account Manager Brazil


At Envu, we partner with our customers to design world-class, forward-thinking innovations that protect and enhance the health of environments around the world. We offer dedicated services in: Professional Pest Management, Forestry, Ornamentals, Golf, Industrial Vegetation Management, Lawn & Landscape, Mosquito Management, and Range & Pasture.


Envu brings together a broad range of perspectives to look beyond chemistry and dare to explore new paths forward. Guided by our inclusive culture, we embrace change and flexibility, tackling our customers’ toughest challenges proactively, passionately and with an entrepreneurial spirit.


We pursue our ambitions collaboratively because we know that a unified and empowered team is an unstoppable force, allowing us to achieve our vision of healthy environments for everyone, everywhere. Join Us.


Envu is proud to be Great Place to Work Certified in the U.S., France and India (June 2025 – June 2026)


FUNCTION: Key Account Manager Brazil

LOCATION: Minas Gerais / Brazil

JOB TYPE: Permanent

JOB GRADE: BR13


GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:


This position is critical to ensuring sustained commercial performance in Minas Gerais and Goiás region, which represents the highest number of distributor and is nationally known as the “Wholesales Headquarters”; this region is the frontier of the 2 high density areas (Southeast and Northeast). The territory covered concentrates a significant portion of national demand. This area is essential to Envu to keep and increase our capillarity.


YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:


This role directly supports execution of the business strategy and is responsible for driving:

  • Sustained revenue growth in the highest-value region in Brazil;
  • Expansion of market share in high-density urban areas;
  • Development of strategic distributor;
  • Strengthening demand generation initiatives and pipeline robustness;
  • Mitigating competitive pressure in the most contested marketplace.
  • Deliver AOP and Financial Targets: Lead business management with partners building and monitoring sell-out campaigns, goals plan, inventory and order management, credit and collection alignment, financial tools, action plan and distributor growth in the medium/long term.
  • Accelerate Business Growth. Expanding market penetration drives new business opportunities.
  • Strengthen Channels: Builds strategic distributor partnerships and increases end-user exposure to maximize portfolio reach.


ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?


Main requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Veterinary Medicine, or Animal Science (Zootechny) required;
  • Relevant experience in commercial roles within agriculture, animal health, or related industries;
  • English Intermediate level required;
  • Willingness to travel frequently;
  • Proven experience working with distributors and/or wholesalers;
  • Solid background in multinational companies;
  • Strong analytical capability, including ability to manage and interpret sell-in and sell-out data;
  • Experience in commercial campaign development and execution;
  • Solid understanding of distribution and channel management (B2B indirect sales model);
  • Results-oriented profile with resilience;
  • Strong ability to work in a dynamic and flexible sales environment;
  • Balanced profile between strategic thinking and operational execution;
  • Commercial experience with urban pest control products.


Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.


By applying for this position, you agree that your personal data are going to be processed and recorded by Envu for recruitment purposes only. For candidates who are not selected for this position, personal data will be kept for a period of two years and then permanently deleted.

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

title: Talent Acquisitions Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisitions Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

This is a full time remote role for a Talent Acquisitions Specialist. The Talent Acquisitions Specialist will be responsible for managing the full recruitment cycle, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, coordinating with hiring managers, and onboarding new employees. Additional tasks include maintaining employee records, providing onboarding administrative support, and supporting the development and implementation of HR initiatives. 


The position follows U.S. Eastern Time business hours, generally Monday through Friday. Working hours will vary slightly throughout the year due to business needs but will typically align with approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM EST.


Qualifications

  • C1 or C2 level of English. Candidates below C1 level will not be considered . 
  • 3-8 years experience in recruitment, sourcing candidates, and conducting interviews
  • Skills in employee relations, HR policies, and labor law compliance
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills
  • The ability to maintain clear, consistent communication with hiring managers and internal stakeholders regarding the status of active searches, candidate pipelines, timelines, and next steps.
  • Proficiency in HR software and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
  • Ability to manage multiple sourcing channels simultaneously, including alternative platforms and outreach methods beyond traditional job boards.
  • Analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field required


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

Key Account Manager Brazil

description:

Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips

  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content

  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Schedule

  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Azure DevOps Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

  • We are seeking a highly skilled and creative Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to provide technical leadership and drive the evolution of our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. In this role, you will not only manage progress on critical projects and provide high-level support, but you will also serve as the technical anchor for our DevOps practices.
  • The ideal candidate blends deep technical proficiency in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem with the creative problem-solving skills required to build elegant, scalable, and secure automation frameworks.


Location: 40% Remote and 60% onsite in São Paulo, Brazil (Paraiso district) - onsite 1 week every 2-3 weeks


Responsibilities:

  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Azure DevOps practices, guiding project architecture and mentoring team members without the burden of administrative people-management.
  • Project Delivery & Support: Ensure steady, measurable progress on core engineering projects while providing robust tier-3 infrastructure and pipeline support.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design, build, and maintain modular, multi-environment (Dev/Test/Prod) infrastructure using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, ensuring strict adherence to state and drift management best practices.
  • CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize sophisticated, multi-stage YAML-based Azure DevOps pipelines to automate infrastructure and application deployments for multi-language stacks (.NET, Python, Node.js, Java).
  • DevSecOps Implementation: Integrate robust security gates, vulnerability scanners, and compliance checks directly into the CI/CD lifecycle.


Experience:

Technical Requirements

Azure Platform Expertise

  • IaC Tools: Proven experience with Terraform (utilizing remote state on Azure Storage), Bicep, or ARM.
  • Azure DevOps Services: Deep familiarity with the full ADO suite (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts).
  • Scripting & Management: Proficiency with Azure CLI, PowerShell (Az module), and REST APIs.
  • Observability: Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Governance & Security: Strong grasp of Azure Policy, Blueprints, RBAC, and Azure Key Vault for secret/certificate management.
  • Containers & Serverless: Foundational knowledge of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Helm, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Functions, and App Services.


CI/CD & Deployment Strategies

  • Mastery of multi-stage YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps (GitHub Actions is a strong plus).
  • Proven track record implementing advanced deployment strategies (Blue-Green, Canary, Rolling).
  • Experience integrating security scanning tools such as SonarQube, WhiteSource, or Snyk into automated pipelines.


Security & Enterprise Compliance

  • Comprehensive understanding of Secure DevOps practices and automated security gates (SCA, IaC scans).
  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) integration and MFA policies.
  • Familiarity with Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and enterprise security baselines is highly desirable.


What Will Make You Successful

  • Technical Proficiency: You have a battle-tested understanding of enterprise Azure environments and CI/CD mechanics. You don't just use tools; you know how they work under the hood.
  • Creativity: You look beyond standard templates to find innovative ways to optimize workflows, solve complex deployment bottlenecks, and design elegant technical solutions.
  • Drive for Progress: You are self-motivated to push projects across the finish line while maintaining high-quality support standards.

Em poucos meses, milhares de empresas já utilizam a plataforma e seguimos em forte crescimento.

Se você gosta de vendas consultivas, tecnologia, gestão empresarial e quer participar da construção de uma empresa com potencial de se tornar uma referência global, essa oportunidade é para você.

Sua Missão

Transformar oportunidades qualificadas em clientes.

Você receberá leads gerados pelo marketing e qualificados pelos SDRs para conduzir diagnósticos, demonstrações e negociações consultivas até o fechamento.

Seu papel não é apenas vender software.

Seu papel é ajudar empresários a resolver problemas de gestão, crescimento, produtividade e execução através da Orbit.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Realizar reuniões de diagnóstico com empresários e gestores.
  • Demonstrar a plataforma Orbit e seus Agentes de IA.
  • Entender desafios relacionados à gestão, processos, pessoas e indicadores.
  • Construir valor antes de falar sobre preço.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais.
  • Conduzir negociações e fechamento.
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos.
  • Alimentar corretamente o CRM.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com SDRs, marketing e onboarding.
  • Atingir metas de receita e conversão.
Perfil que Buscamos

Você terá grande chance de sucesso se:

  • Gosta de vender.
  • É competitivo e orientado a resultados.
  • Tem facilidade para conduzir reuniões executivas.
  • Sabe ouvir e fazer perguntas inteligentes.
  • Consegue conversar com donos de empresas.
  • Possui visão de negócios.
  • É disciplinado na gestão do pipeline.
  • Aprende rápido e se adapta a mudanças.
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência em vendas consultivas.
  • Experiência conduzindo reuniões online.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Domínio de algum CRM.
  • Capacidade de negociação.
  • Organização comercial.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com SaaS.
  • Experiência com vendas B2B.
  • Experiência com gestão empresarial.
  • Experiência com ERP, CRM ou softwares de gestão.
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial.
  • Experiência em vendas de alto valor agregado.
O Que Você Vai Vender

A Orbit atende principalmente empresas que:

  • Possuem mais de 30 colaboradores.
  • Faturam acima de R$ 500 mil por mês.
  • Estão enfrentando desafios de crescimento.
  • Precisam melhorar gestão, processos e execução.

Você venderá uma plataforma que combina:

  • Gestão Estratégica
  • Gestão de Processos
  • Gestão de Pessoas
  • Indicadores
  • Agentes de IA especializados
Indicadores da Função

Você será acompanhado por métricas como:

  • Taxa de conversão de reunião para proposta.
  • Taxa de conversão de proposta para venda.
  • Receita gerada.
  • Ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas.
  • Forecast e previsibilidade do pipeline.
Faixa de Ganhos

Buscamos profissionais que queiram construir uma remuneração acima da média do mercado.

Estrutura:

  • Salário fixo.
  • Comissão sem teto.
  • Aceleradores por performance.

Profissionais de alta performance possuem potencial para ganhos expressivos conforme os resultados entregues.

Modelo de Trabalho
  • Presencial em Florianópolis/SC.
  • Horário comercial.
  • Contratação PJ.
Quem Não Deve Se Candidatar

Esta vaga não é para quem:

  • Espera vendas simples e transacionais.
  • Tem dificuldade em falar com empresários e tomadores de decisão.
  • Não gosta de metas.
  • Busca apenas estabilidade.
  • Não gosta de tecnologia ou inovação.
Quem Mais Cresce na Orbit

Pessoas que entendem que vender é ajudar empresas a crescer.

Buscamos profissionais que enxergam a oportunidade de participar da construção de uma empresa de tecnologia em forte expansão e que querem construir uma carreira relevante no mercado de SaaS e Inteligência Artificial.

Se você é movido por desafios, performance e crescimento profissional, a Orbit é o lugar certo para você.

  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Elementary Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Elementary Teacher em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position: Elementary Teacher

Section: Elementary School

Application Deadline: June 12, 2026

Start Date: July 15, 2026


Main responsibilities: Plan and deliver engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences aligned with the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) and the Nations Learning Ecosystem. Differentiate instruction using Universal Design for Learning (UDL) to support diverse learners. Implement, document, and continuously improve curriculum units using the Understanding by Design (UbD) framework and Toddle platform. Assess student learning through diagnostic, formative, and summative assessments, using data to inform instruction and provide meaningful feedback. Foster a safe, inclusive, and student-centered classroom environment that promotes agency, belonging, and academic growth. Collaborate with colleagues, Learning Support specialists, and families to support student success. Integrate technology, AI tools, moral values, and global perspectives into teaching and learning. 


Requirements: Pedagogy degree  (Pedagogia). Fluency in English (Portuguese is desirable). Teaching experience, preferably in bilingual or international settings. Ability to work effectively with students from diverse cultural backgrounds. Experience with the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) or willingness to undergo IB training. Strong curriculum planning, assessment, and classroom management skills. Ability to create engaging, rigorous, and inclusive learning experiences. Commitment to professional ethics, continuous growth, and working effectively within a diverse international community.


About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.


Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.


In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.


Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.


School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.


Cargo: Professor(a) de Ensino Fundamental I

Segmento: Ensino Fundamental I

Prazo de Inscrição: 12 de junho de 2026

Data de início: 15 de julho de 2026


Principais responsabilidades: Planejar e conduzir experiências de aprendizagem baseadas em investigação, alinhadas ao Programa de Anos Iniciais do International Baccalaureate (IB PYP) e ao Ecossistema de Aprendizagem da Escola das Nações. Diferenciar a instrução utilizando os princípios do Universal Design for Learning (UDL), atendendo às necessidades de estudantes com diferentes perfis de aprendizagem. Implementar, documentar e aprimorar continuamente unidades curriculares utilizando a metodologia Understanding by Design (UbD). Avaliar a aprendizagem dos alunos por meio de avaliações diagnósticas, formativas e somativas, utilizando dados para orientar o ensino e fornecer feedback significativo. Promover um ambiente de sala de aula seguro, inclusivo e centrado no aluno, favorecendo autonomia, pertencimento e crescimento acadêmico. Colaborar com colegas, especialistas de Suporte à Aprendizagem e famílias para apoiar o sucesso dos estudantes. Integrar tecnologia, ferramentas de inteligência artificial, valores morais e perspectivas globais ao processo de ensino e aprendizagem. 


Requisitos: Graduação em Pedagogia. Fluência em inglês (português é desejável). Experiência docente, preferencialmente em contextos bilíngues ou internacionais. Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz com estudantes de diferentes origens culturais. Experiência com o Programa de Anos Iniciais do International Baccalaureate (IB PYP) ou disponibilidade para participar dos treinamentos. Sólidas habilidades de planejamento curricular, avaliação da aprendizagem e gestão de sala de aula. Capacidade de criar experiências de aprendizagem envolventes, desafiadoras e inclusivas. Compromisso com a ética profissional, o desenvolvimento contínuo e o trabalho colaborativo em uma comunidade internacional diversa.


Sobre a empresa: A Escola das Nações é uma instituição internacional, privada, sem fins lucrativos, coeducacional e duolinguística (inglês e português), localizada em Brasília. Oferecemos um programa educacional que vai do berçário ao 12º ano e somos credenciados internacionalmente pela NEASC e, nacionalmente, pela Secretaria de Educação do Distrito Federal. Com estudantes e colaboradores de 30 países e origens diversas, promovemos um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo que incentiva a cidadania global e valoriza a diversidade.


Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.


Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.


A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.


A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

title: Customer Service Representative

Customer Service Representative

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.

Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.


The Role

This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.

You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
  • You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
  • You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
  • You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
  • You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You avoid dealing with difficult customers
  • You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
  • You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms


What You'll Do

Customer Support Execution

  • Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
  • Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
  • Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice

Social Media Support

  • Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency

Order & Refund Management

  • Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
  • Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed

Conflict Resolution

  • Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
  • Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
  • Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations


Requirements

Must have:

  • Experience in customer service (ecommerce or DTC preferred)
  • +1 years of experience using Shopify
  • Strong written communication skills in English
  • Experience handling social media interactions is a strong plus
  • High attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM.
  • Monthly salary: $3,000 - $4,000 USD
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business

Ready to Apply?

If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

title: AI Practice Lead | Arquiteto de Soluções de IA
description:

Dicas: forneça um resumo do cargo, como teria sucesso no cargo eLíder de Prática de IA | AI Practice Lead — Sênior

inQuesti | Consultoria em Data Analytics & IA


Venha construir a prática de IA da inQuesti do zero!


Somos uma consultoria especializada em Data Analytics e Inteligência Artificial, 

ajudando grandes empresas brasileiras e multinacionais a transformar dados em 

eficiência operacional, melhores decisões e resultados tangíveis de negócio.


Temos uma base sólida em engenharia de dados, BI e governança — e agora estamos 

construindo nossa prática de Inteligência Artificial. Não estamos buscando alguém 

para executar tarefas: estamos buscando a pessoa que vai liderar essa construção. 

Alguém que chegue com visão, referências e capacidade de estruturar uma linha de 

serviços de IA que gere valor real para nossos clientes — e receita real para a 

inQuesti.


Se você já construiu (ou ajudou a construir) uma prática de IA em consultoria, 

sabe orientar clientes enterprise sobre por onde começar, consegue fazer uma demo 

que convence e tem a maturidade para transformar demanda confusa em proposta 

estruturada — queremos muito te conhecer.



O que você vai fazer?


* Liderar a construção da prática de IA da inQuesti: metodologia, portfólio de 

serviços, aceleradores e demos que viram cases reais;

* Conduzir assessments e workshops com clientes para mapear oportunidades de IA, 

definir prioridades e estruturar roadmaps de adoção;

* Apoiar ativamente o processo comercial: participar de reuniões de venda, 

apresentar demos, construir propostas e ser a referência técnica que gera 

confiança no cliente;

* Desenhar e implementar soluções de IA generativa: agentes, sistemas 

multiagentes, automações inteligentes, copilots corporativos e integrações com 

sistemas existentes;

* Atuar com múltiplos stacks conforme o contexto do cliente — Microsoft Copilot 

Studio, Azure AI, Python/LangChain/LangGraph, Claude, OpenAI e outros;

* Apoiar clientes na adoção de ferramentas de produtividade com IA (Microsoft 

Copilot, Claude), incluindo treinamentos e estratégias de change management;

* Orientar e desenvolver o time interno da inQuesti em IA, elevando a capacidade 

técnica da empresa como um todo;

* Definir boas práticas, padrões e frameworks que guiem a entrega de projetos de 

IA com qualidade e consistência.



O que buscamos?


* 6+ anos de experiência em tecnologia, com pelo menos 3 anos focados em IA 

aplicada ou soluções de dados avançadas;

* Experiência comprovada em consultoria ou Microsoft Partner — você já esteve 

na frente de clientes enterprise orientando sobre IA, não só entregando projetos;

* Domínio prático de IA generativa: LLMs, agentes, RAG, engenharia de prompt, 

orquestração e integração com sistemas corporativos;

* Capacidade de transitar entre múltiplos stacks — Microsoft (Copilot Studio, 

Azure OpenAI, Power Platform) e open-source (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI ou 

similares);

* Perfil consultivo e comercial: confortável em reuniões de C-level, sabe 

construir argumentos de valor e apresentar demos que vendem;

* Capacidade de estruturar metodologias, criar aceleradores e transformar 

experiências em ativos replicáveis;

* Comunicação excepcional — você traduz complexidade técnica em linguagem de 

negócio sem perder precisão.



⭐ Diferenciais valorizados


* Experiência prévia construindo ou liderando uma prática de IA em consultoria 

ou empresa de tecnologia;

* Portfólio de demos, aceleradores ou soluções de IA já construídas e 

apresentadas a clientes enterprise;

* Experiência com Microsoft Copilot Studio em projetos reais com grandes empresas;

* Conhecimento em avaliação de LLMs, observabilidade de agentes e critérios de 

qualidade para soluções de IA em produção;

* Vivência com estratégias de adoção e change management para ferramentas de IA 

corporativa;

* Certificações relevantes: Microsoft AI-102, AZ-900, DP-600 ou equivalentes;

* Experiência com Azure AI Foundry, AI Search ou ecossistema Azure aplicado a IA.



Sobre a Contratação


* Contratação em regime PJ;

* Remuneração: até R$ 20.000/mês, compatível com o nível e impacto esperados;

* Carga horária: 8h/dia (horário comercial);

* Modelo Híbrido (2x na semana - Avenida Paulista);

* Protagonismo real: você vai construir a prática de IA da inQuesti — com 

autonomia, influência direta nos resultados e visibilidade junto aos maiores 

clientes do Brasil;

* Ambiente colaborativo com base sólida em dados — você não começa do zero, 

começa com estrutura;

* Exposição constante a novos desafios, tecnologias e aprendizado contínuo;

* Day off no aniversário;

* Wellhub (antigo Gympass).como este cargo se encaixa na organização em geral.

title: Senior Creative Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Creative Director em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Director

Talent Global LLC — Remote

Part-Time (10 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client is a US-based performance marketing agency that builds and scales creative content for brands across paid social and digital channels. They are looking for a Creative Director to serve as the internal quality gate for all creative output — both video and graphics — before it reaches the client. This person will work closely with the agency's leadership team, taking ownership of creative review, direction, and strategy across active accounts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and QA all video and graphic creative assets before client delivery, ensuring quality, brand alignment, and strategic clarity
  • Provide clear, actionable creative direction to designers and video editors based on client briefs and performance goals
  • Develop creative strategies for new content batches — defining concept, visual direction, messaging angle, and format
  • Identify creative weaknesses across active accounts and propose improvements proactively
  • Maintain a high creative bar across all output, with strong attention to detail in both visual execution and storytelling


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Senior Art Director, or equivalent role at a marketing agency or performance-focused creative team
  • Strong portfolio spanning both video and graphic content — social ads, brand content, or performance creative
  • Ability to both review/direct existing work and develop new creative strategies from scratch
  • Deep understanding of what makes creative perform on paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working with or managing designers and video editors
  • Excellent written and verbal English — able to communicate creative feedback clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and highly detail-oriented — comfortable working async with a lean team
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, or similar) is a plus


Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who has a natural eye for what's working and what isn't — and can articulate why with precision. They thrive in fast-moving agency environments where standards are high and feedback cycles are tight. They are equally comfortable directing a video edit and reviewing a static ad set, and they understand that creative strategy and execution are inseparable. They don't need to be reminded to raise the bar — they set it.

title: Senior Creative Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Creative Director em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Director

Talent Global LLC — Remote

Part-Time (10 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client is a US-based performance marketing agency that builds and scales creative content for brands across paid social and digital channels. They are looking for a Creative Director to serve as the internal quality gate for all creative output — both video and graphics — before it reaches the client. This person will work closely with the agency's leadership team, taking ownership of creative review, direction, and strategy across active accounts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and QA all video and graphic creative assets before client delivery, ensuring quality, brand alignment, and strategic clarity
  • Provide clear, actionable creative direction to designers and video editors based on client briefs and performance goals
  • Develop creative strategies for new content batches — defining concept, visual direction, messaging angle, and format
  • Identify creative weaknesses across active accounts and propose improvements proactively
  • Maintain a high creative bar across all output, with strong attention to detail in both visual execution and storytelling


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Senior Art Director, or equivalent role at a marketing agency or performance-focused creative team
  • Strong portfolio spanning both video and graphic content — social ads, brand content, or performance creative
  • Ability to both review/direct existing work and develop new creative strategies from scratch
  • Deep understanding of what makes creative perform on paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working with or managing designers and video editors
  • Excellent written and verbal English — able to communicate creative feedback clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and highly detail-oriented — comfortable working async with a lean team
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, or similar) is a plus


Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who has a natural eye for what's working and what isn't — and can articulate why with precision. They thrive in fast-moving agency environments where standards are high and feedback cycles are tight. They are equally comfortable directing a video edit and reviewing a static ad set, and they understand that creative strategy and execution are inseparable. They don't need to be reminded to raise the bar — they set it.

Sobre a QMC Telecom Internacional:

Atuamos em um setor dinâmico, com cultura orientada a resultados e times que combinam visão regional com execução local.


Sobre a posição:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de Software — Backend & Automação | Local: São Paulo – Brasil (modelo remoto).


Essa posição integra o time de desenvolvimento da QMC responsável pelas soluções que apoiam a tomada de decisão das áreas de vendas, negócio e operação. A pessoa nessa função construirá e manterá serviços de backend, rotinas de automação e integrações entre sistemas, incluindo soluções com uso de IA como ferramenta de apoio quando fizer sentido para o problema.

A posição reporta diretamente ao Asset Efficiency & Data Science Manager e trabalha lado a lado com os times de dados, desenvolvimento e áreas de negócio.


Sobre a área:


O time de desenvolvimento da QMC atua na construção de ferramentas e soluções internas que conectam dados operacionais à tomada de decisão estratégica. É um time enxuto, de alta autonomia, onde cada pessoa tem impacto direto e visível nos produtos que entrega. Aqui valorizamos código bem estruturado, documentação séria e a capacidade de transformar problemas mal definidos em soluções funcionais.


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter serviços de backend e APIs em Python para uso em produção;
  • Construir rotinas de automação de processos e tarefas repetitivas;
  • Integrar APIs externas e serviços de IA/LLM às soluções do time quando fizer sentido para o problema;
  • Apoiar na modelagem e consulta de bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL);
  • Conteinerizar aplicações e apoiar o deploy com Docker;
  • Trabalhar com mensageria e integração entre serviços (ex.: RabbitMQ) (conhecimento desejável);
  • Documentar o que é desenvolvido: código, arquitetura e decisões técnicas.


Formação Acadêmica:


Superior Completo em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas de tecnologia/exatas.


Experiência Profissional:


  • Mínimo de 2 anos com Python em ambiente de produção : serviços, APIs e automações (requisito eliminatório);
  • Mínimo de 2 anos com SQL / PostgreSQL : consultas e modelagem de dados;
  • Mínimo de 1 ano em automação de processos e integração de APIs ;
  • Experiência com Docker e ambientes conteinerizados (desejável);
  • Experiência com Node.js / TypeScript (desejável).


Conhecimentos Técnicos. Requisitos obrigatórios:


  • Python sólido para produção: estruturação de projeto, testes, integração com bancos de dados e APIs externas;
  • SQL e modelagem de dados com PostgreSQL;
  • Automação: scripts de processo, tarefas agendadas, integração entre sistemas;
  • Docker e ambientes conteinerizados;
  • Controle de versão com Git;
  • Capacidade de construir prompts eficazes para LLMs e consumir APIs de IA em código (autenticação, requisição, parsing de resposta, tratamento de erro e controle de custo/tokens);
  • Metodologias ágeis.


Diferenciais desejáveis:


  • Node.js / TypeScript;
  • Mensageria com RabbitMQ ou equivalente;
  • Orquestração de pipelines com Airflow ou equivalente;
  • Automação web com Selenium;
  • PostGIS / dados geoespaciais;


Ferramentas e Sistemas:


  • Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git (fundamental).
  • Node.js, TypeScript, RabbitMQ, Airflow, Selenium (Desejáveis).


Idiomas


  • Inglês — requisito (leitura técnica e documentação);
  • Espanhol — diferencial (operação LatAm).

About the Role

Our client company (a US-based Creative Agency) is looking for 2–3 highly creative AI-native talents who can combine generative AI, motion design, video editing, and visual storytelling to create modern, high-performing social content for brands and ventures.


This is not a traditional graphic design or video editing role. We are looking for creatives who deeply understand internet aesthetics, AI-powered workflows, cinematic social visuals, and short-form content that captures attention immediately.


You will work across AI-generated imagery, motion graphics, editing, creative direction, and experimental visual concepts to produce premium content similar to the examples below:

  • Fast-paced visual storytelling
  • AI-generated cinematic visuals
  • Social-first brand content
  • Stylized motion design
  • Creative AI advertising assets
  • Premium/High-end startup and venture-style aesthetics

  • Create visually compelling AI-powered social content for Instagram and paid ads
  • Produce short-form videos using AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, editing, and sound design
  • Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling ideas from briefs or creative direction
  • Use generative AI tools to create unique imagery, animations, environments, and visual sequences
  • Edit high-quality content with strong pacing, transitions, typography, and cinematic composition
  • Stay up to date with AI creative trends, social content trends, and emerging tools
  • Maintain strong brand aesthetics and visual consistency across projects
  • Iterate quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced startup environment


Ideal Candidate

  • Strong portfolio showcasing AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, or cinematic social content
  • Experience creating modern social-first creative content for startups, agencies, brands, or creators
  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, typography, and internet culture
  • Ability to combine creativity with execution speed
  • Self-directed, proactive, and highly collaborative
  • Strong aesthetic taste and attention to detail
  • Comfortable experimenting with new creative workflows and AI tools


Preferred Tools & Skills

Experience with several of the following:

  • Runway

FairSplit.com , a small American company, helps families navigate estate, downsizing, death, or divorce by providing a web app for building inventories and then dividing assets among beneficiaries. This tool can be used by professionals assisting families or directly by family members.


Our motto is \"Divide things, not families\". The best thing about working for FairSplit is the certainty that we are making the world better, by helping people in rare, delicate moments of their lives .

This is a **remote, freelance role for a senior backend Python developer**. You will work with other members of an agile team to write server-side logic and integrate front-end elements.


No agencies, please. Only individuals.


Payment is per hour worked. Hourly value dependent on your demonstrable experience. All work is remote.


This is a ~3-month-long position with a good chance of extending further.

- the Python language, with typing annotations

- SQLAlchemy (the Python ORM)

- the Starlette web framework (basis of FastAPI)

- the Pyramid web framework (legacy for us)

- git


## Requisites


- Fluent English.

- Committed to working 40h per week .

- Experience with back-end development and database design.

- Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.

- Deep knowledge about security and scalability of web apps.

- Interest in the themes of software architecture, open source and agile.

- Interest in pair programming.

- Attention to detail and precision in the use of language.

- Good communication: you don't disappear, you don't shun video calls, you are present in our Discord group while working, you ask for help when needed, you write on kanban cards to provide insight into your work and you spontaneously provide advice when you see the opportunity.

title: Project Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Consultant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

At Toluna, we keep the world’s biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we’ve been a leader in consumer insights, and today we’re at the center of our industry’s biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.


Brands come to us because we’ve solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we’ve been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries.


Introduction:

Responsible for managing Toluna's market research projects, the Project Consultant will be representing Toluna to our wide range of clients in the global market. The goal is to work on and coordinate projects from beginning to end under strict timelines, handling multiple projects simultaneously and interacting with Toluna’s internal operations teams while providing the best service to our clients. The Project Consultant will deliver a great client experience by meeting clients' strategic insights needs and will be supporting US-based clients while reporting to the North American-based client services team.


Responsibilities:

  • Provide exceptional client service while cultivating strategic, long-term partnerships
  • Advocate for clients’ needs to ensure alignment with project objectives and service standards
  • Demonstrate expertise in the Toluna Start platform and champion its use with clients
  • Independently manage full service, field & tab, and assisted-DIY research projects
  • Review and optimize questionnaire logic, providing recommendations to clients
  • Manage workload successfully by planning and prioritising all tasks and projects
  • Support clients and internal teams in achieving clients' research objectives
  • Liaise with other internal departments and external partners
  • Devise detailed internal and client project plans and ensure client needs are met and exceeded where possible
  • Check and compare actual project requirements against cost
  • Be the point of contact of our clients
  • Program surveys or work with internal programming team (according to agreed rules)
  • Ensure programming edits are implemented accurately, and survey test link is checked before sending to client
  • Manage overall project coordination, monitoring schedules, project margins, key deliverables, and client expectations
  • Update client on progress at regular intervals and provide regular fieldwork updates to the client
  • Perform data quality checks, including regular review and removal of poor-quality open-ended responses
  • Monitor fieldwork either fielded by you or fielded by the Field management team (according to agreed rules)


Your profile:

  • Experience: Minimum of 4 years in a project management role within market research, with expertise in managing complex projects
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced understanding of survey programming, questionnaire logic, and data metrics. Familiarity with programming platforms like Toluna Start, Confirmit, or related tools is essential
  • Project Management: Proven ability to independently manage multiple high-complexity projects while meeting tight deadlines
  • Artificial Intelligence: Proactive in adopting and leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, insight generation, and overall project performance
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to build client relationships and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Languages: Advanced English is mandatory; additional language skills are a plus.
  • Professional Traits: Proactive, adaptable, and self-motivated, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Approaches challenges with initiative, resourcefulness, and a positive drive to deliver results and can work independently while contributing effectively to team objectives.


Our Values:

A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability

B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial

C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness

D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly

E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, unlimited access to Udemy Business, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. If you’re passionate about making an impact on colleagues around the globe, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal voucher, transportation voucher TotalPass, and language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

description:

Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

title: Teacher Assistant
description:

Start Date: July 15, 2026 


Main responsibilities: Support, guide, and assist students, fostering their social, emotional, cognitive, and academic development; support students’ needs related to care, well-being, and the learning process; supervise and accompany students during arrival, dismissal, recess, and other moments throughout the school routine; assist in the implementation of proposed educational and pedagogical activities; support the lead teacher in the planning and development of lessons and activities; contribute to maintaining a welcoming, safe, and stimulating learning environment; provide classroom coverage during teacher absences, when necessary.

Ability to work collaboratively with a positive and cooperative attitude. Strong alignment with the school’s vision, mission, and values.


About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.


Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.


In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.


Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.


School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.

Requisitos: Bilíngue em português e inglês. Graduação (licenciatura) em Pedagogia. Experiência com crianças em idade do Ensino Fundamental I. Pontualidade, responsabilidade e flexibilidade. Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe com uma atitude positiva e colaborativa. Forte identificação com a visão, missão e valores da escola.


Sobre a empresa: A Escola das Nações é uma instituição internacional, privada, sem fins lucrativos, coeducacional e duolinguística (inglês e português), localizada em Brasília. Oferecemos um programa educacional que vai do berçário ao 12º ano e somos credenciados internacionalmente pela NEASC e, nacionalmente, pela Secretaria de Educação do Distrito Federal. Com estudantes e colaboradores de 30 países e origens diversas, promovemos um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo que incentiva a cidadania global e valoriza a diversidade.


Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.


Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.


A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.


A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

description:

Section: Elementary School

Main responsibilities: Support, guide, and assist students, fostering their social, emotional, cognitive, and academic development; support students’ needs related to care, well-being, and the learning process; supervise and accompany students during arrival, dismissal, recess, and other moments throughout the school routine; assist in the implementation of proposed educational and pedagogical activities; support the lead teacher in the planning and development of lessons and activities; contribute to maintaining a welcoming, safe, and stimulating learning environment; provide classroom coverage during teacher absences, when necessary.
