title: Arquiteto de Dados Consultor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de Dados Consultor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Copel

Somos a Copel, uma das maiores empresas integradas de energia do Brasil com atuação em geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização. Nossa força vem da nossa gente. Nós criamos as nossas próprias oportunidades e reconhecemos o potencial das pessoas, pois sabemos que cada um pode contribuir e fortalecer ainda mais a equipe. Buscamos profissionais que querem se desenvolver junto com o negócio e que estejam preparados para grandes desafios: da infraestrutura que move o Brasil às soluções sustentáveis que protegem o amanhã. Somos feitos de energia e atitude. Venha fazer parte da Copel.


Arquiteto de Dados Consultor

(Enterprise Architecture | Hybrid & Multi-Cloud)


Modelo de atuação 100% presencial com atuação em Curitiba


Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto de Dados Consultor para liderar a modernização e a governança de um ecossistema complexo e distribuído. O desafio envolve orquestrar uma arquitetura que integra o core no GCP com sistemas críticos em AWS, OCI (SAP S/4) e infraestruturas On-premises, garantindo uma transição fluida para modelos de Data Mesh, Data Fabric e Lakehouse, sempre alinhada aos rigorosos padrões da Arquitetura Corporativa (TOGAF). É essencial ter conhecimento e experiência na construção de Data Products.

Buscamos um arquiteto que una o rigor acadêmico à vivência prática de mercado. Este profissional será o maestro da integração tecnológica da Copel, assegurando que a inovação aconteça com segurança, transparência e alta disponibilidade técnica.



Principais atividades da vaga

  • Design de Arquitetura Híbrida (On-premise & Cloud): Projetar e gerenciar a integração entre o legado físico e a nuvem, garantindo a integridade do dado.
  • Governança e Modelos de Entrega: Implementar o paradigma de Data Mesh e modelos Hub-and-Spoke, provendo ambientes de Sandbox seguros e estruturas de consumo para produtos de dados.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Definir e acompanhar métricas de saúde de infraestrutura e pipelines, garantindo visibilidade total sobre a operação.
  • Modernização Real-Time (Stream): Implementar estratégias de ingestão em modalidade Stream e fluxos transacionais.
  • Design de Soluções (As-Is e To-Be): Mapear o estado atual e projetar o roadmap futuro, documentando regras de negócio e pipelines.
  • Gestão de Engenharia e Qualidade: Garantir a aplicação de modelos de Fato e Dimensão com rotinas de validação na infraestrutura.
  • Gestão de Alta Performance: Atuar com foco em Metas e Resultados, realizando a gestão de prazos, recursos físicos e financeiros (FinOps).
  • Definição de arquitetura de governança e virtualização de dados.
  • Definição e implantação de ferramentas de aquisição, com construção completa de pipelines de ingestão de dados.
  • Atuar como referência técnica, mentorando o time e disseminando conhecimento sobre as plataformas e tecnologias adotadas.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de dados ponta a ponta, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e segurança.
  • Definir modelos de dados otimizados para custo e eficiência.
  • Estabelecer modelo de orquestração e otimizar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) em ambientes batch e streaming.



Principais requisitos da vaga

  • Formação Acadêmica: Sólida formação em Engenharia de Software, Computação ou Ciência da Computação ou cursos correlatos com especialização em Dados.
  • Idiomas: Habilidade avançada com a língua inglesa (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Comunicação Interpessoal: Habilidade para influenciar stakeholders executivos e orientar times técnicos.
  • Domínio de Ambientes Híbridos: Experiência comprovada na integração de ambientes On-premises com soluções Cloud.
  • Frameworks e Metodologias: Conhecimento sólido em TOGAF e experiência com modelos Hub-and-Spoke/Sandbox.
  • Especialista em Cloud (GCP): Domínio de BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer e AlloyDB.
  • Multi-Cloud e Bancos de Dados: Vivência com AWS, OCI e Bancos Oracle CDB/PDB, MongoDB e AlloyDB, CloudSQl, BigTable.



Serão diferenciais para a vaga

  • Certificações Cloud: Certificações oficiais Google Cloud (GCP Professional Data Engineer).
  • Tecnologias Emergentes: Experiência com Denodo e uso de IA para aceleração de desenvolvimento de atividades de engenharia de dados.
  • Desejável experiência na ferramenta Denodo.
  • Participação na estruturação de processos.


Benefícios

Na Copel você encontra benefícios pensados para apoiar a sua jornada! Prêmios por Desempenho (PPD) e Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR). Suporte completo para você e sua família com Auxílio Creche, Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendida.


Call to Action

Conheça essa e outras oportunidades em nossa Página de Carreiras e no LinkedIn. Nossas vagas também estão abertas para candidaturas de Pessoas com Deficiência (PCDs).

Esta é uma função flexível baseada em cooperação, adequada para profissionais com experiência em sistemas de energia, engenharia elétrica, distribuição elétrica, UPS, baterias, aterramento, proteção contra descargas atmosféricas, cabos, telecomunicações, data centers, instalações industriais, manutenção elétrica ou projetos de infraestrutura.

R$181,130 to R$524,000 CAD | Remote Brazil | Unlimited PTO


WeTransact is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team.

title: Supervisor(a) de Atendimento (Central de Relacionamento Saúde)

Seguros Unimed


Somos a Seguros Unimed , a Seguradora do Sistema Unimed, uma empresa criada por médicos e que tem o cooperativismo na essência. Cuidamos das instituições e das pessoas, para que possam viver bem o presente e planejar o futuro com segurança. Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.


Pelo 7º ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025 , da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!


Siga nossa página aqui no LinkedIn e fique por dentro de nossas oportunidades de carreira.

Venha fazer parte da Seguros Unimed e ter uma Jornada Incrível conosco!


O que oferecemos nessa Jornada

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • PPR - Programa de Participação nos Resultados;
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Vale transporte ou desconto em estacionamento;

Além disso, você encontra por aqui

  • Modelo de Trabalho híbrido;

  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos e trilhas de desenvolvimento;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.


No seu dia-a-dia

  • Apoiar na criação das metas da equipe;
  • Conduzir a contratação e integração de novos funcionários;

title: Subject Matter Expert - Banking
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Banking em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview

We’re hiring banking and fintech professionals with hands-on experience across Chase, PayPal, Venmo, and Mint to evaluate AI systems handling payments, disputes, fraud, and personal finance scenarios.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Create banking and payments workflow prompts
  • Build synthetic transaction, dispute, and reconciliation scenarios
  • Evaluate AI responses for accuracy and compliance
  • Identify issues like failed transfers, fraud false positives, and sync failures


Requirements

  • 4–9+ years in banking, fintech, fraud ops, merchant payments, or personal finance
  • Experience with Chase, PayPal, Venmo, Mint, or related platforms
  • Understanding of consumer banking regulations (Reg E, Reg Z, AML/KYC)
  • Strong analytical and written communication skills
  • Comfort using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude


Nice to have

  • Experience with Stripe, Square, Cash App, Plaid, or Robinhood
  • AI evaluation or RLHF experience
  • Knowledge of fintech integrations and data aggregation


Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Work in a fully remote environment.


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated end‑to‑end test cases using Cypress Test across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers.

title: DevOps Engineer (Freelancer)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DevOps Engineer (Freelancer) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro DevOps talentoso e proativo para integrar nossa equipe de arquitetura de soluções. Você será o responsável por projetar, implementar e manter o ciclo de vida de entrega contínua (CI/CD) para uma plataforma crítica de configuração de Inteligência Artificial, com foco principal em implantações on-premise sobre Linux, mas também apoiando nossa evolução para a nuvem.

Sua missão será garantir que o fluxo do desenvolvimento até a produção seja automatizado, seguro e eficiente, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com desenvolvedores Fullstack e especialistas em IA.


Responsabilidades Principais

• Automação CI/CD: Projetar e administrar pipelines declarativos no Jenkins para aplicações Python (Backend) e Vue.js (Frontend).

• Gestão de Infraestrutura On-Premise: Configurar e otimizar servidores Linux (Ubuntu) para implantações locais de alta disponibilidade.

• Conteinerização: Implementar e gerenciar serviços utilizando Docker e Docker Compose, garantindo a portabilidade dos módulos da plataforma.

• Segurança e Monitoramento: Implementar as melhores práticas de segurança no armazenamento de credenciais e rastreabilidade de alterações.

• Suporte à Implantação: Colaborar na instalação e configuração da solução diretamente na infraestrutura física de nossos clientes.


Requisitos Técnicos

• Sólida experiência na administração de servidores Linux (administração de sistemas, redes, segurança).

• Domínio avançado de Jenkins (Pipelines as Code, Shared Libraries).

• Experiência prática com Docker e ferramentas de orquestração.

• Conhecimento em administração de bancos de dados MySQL (backups, otimização e migrações).

• Capacidade de desenvolver scripts de automação em Python ou Bash.


Qualificações Desejáveis (Diferenciais)

• Experiência com serviços da AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM) para suporte a ambientes híbridos.

• Vivência em projetos de implantação de modelos de IA ou Machine Learning.

• Mentalidade de \"Infraestrutura como Código\" (Terraform ou Ansible).


Você está pronto para este desafio? Candidate-se agora e ajude-nos a construir o futuro da configuração de IA!

title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring account managers who'd rather grow a customer than keep one.


R$181,130 to R$524,000 CAD | Remote Brazil | Unlimited PTO


WeTransact is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team.


Your Mission

  • Own the account after go-live : You're the customer's main point of contact once they're live and transactable, and you're accountable for their revenue growth on the marketplace.
  • Advise on the right path : You assess where each ISV is and recommend the program or plan that moves them forward, from IP Co-sell eligibility to Certified Software status to new channels.
  • Drive adoption into revenue : You implement the work that converts a live listing into transactions: CRM integration, Crossbeam setup, sales comp parity, and Microsoft incentives.
  • Challenge the customer : When results aren't there, you challenge their structure and bring them a revised plan rather than a status update.
  • Navigating the Microsoft Field : You connect customers to the right AEs and PDMs and build the co-sell motion that moves deals.
  • Compounding with AI : AI is part of your daily workflow across research, QBR prep, and pipeline. This isn't a perk we offer, it's how we operate.


What We're Looking For

  • +4 years in sales at a B2B tech company. Quota-carrying, with a track record of growing accounts. CSM or account management background is a plus, not a substitute.
  • You think in revenue. Adoption is the means, not the metric.
  • English fluent. You present to Customer or Microsoft stakeholders in English without prep.
  • Daily, instinctive use of AI tools.
  • Comfortable being the one who tells a customer their approach isn't working — and what to do instead.
  • You manage 30+ accounts without dropping the ball.


What You Get

  • Unlimited PTO.
  • AI-first culture across the business.
  • Direct access to Microsoft teams and the partner ecosystem most companies spend years trying to reach.
  • Real ownership of a revenue book, measured in outcomes not activity.
  • Path to senior measured in quarters, not years.
  • Global team in more than 12 countries with a strong culture.


About WeTransact

Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

title: Assessor de Investimentos especialista em Empresas (PJ) | B2B
description:

A VMB Invest é um escritório credenciado à XP Investimentos, reconhecido como um dos 10 escritórios que mais crescem da XP. O Grupo VMB Invest é um Ecossistema 360° completo de planejamento financeiro, focado no público de Alta Renda, médicos e empresários, integrando investimentos, câmbio, consultoria e soluções como planos de saúde e consórcio, e muito mais.


Site da VMB Invest | Clique aqui!

Estamos em busca de um Assessor de Investimentos com foco no segmento PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) | Empresas/B2B , que atuará diretamente com empresas, e construindo relacionamento com os decisores por trás do negócio. • Certificação ANCORD (obrigatória) ou disponibilidade para obtenção no curto prazo.

• Experiência com atendimento ou prospecção de clientes PJ será considerada um diferencial.

title: Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Azure DevOps Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer

Duration: 6+ Months

Location: 40% Remote and 60% onsite in São Paulo, Brazil (Paraiso district) - onsite 1 week every 2-3 weeks


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and creative Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to provide technical leadership and drive the evolution of our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. In this role, you will not only manage progress on critical projects and provide high-level support, but you will also serve as the technical anchor for our DevOps practices.

The ideal candidate blends deep technical proficiency in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem with the creative problem-solving skills required to build elegant, scalable, and secure automation frameworks.


Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Azure DevOps practices, guiding project architecture and mentoring team members without the burden of administrative people-management.
  • Project Delivery & Support: Ensure steady, measurable progress on core engineering projects while providing robust tier-3 infrastructure and pipeline support.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design, build, and maintain modular, multi-environment (Dev/Test/Prod) infrastructure using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, ensuring strict adherence to state and drift management best practices.
  • CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize sophisticated, multi-stage YAML-based Azure DevOps pipelines to automate infrastructure and application deployments for multi-language stacks (.NET, Python, Node.js, Java).
  • DevSecOps Implementation: Integrate robust security gates, vulnerability scanners, and compliance checks directly into the CI/CD lifecycle.


Azure Platform Expertise

  • IaC Tools: Proven experience with Terraform (utilizing remote state on Azure Storage), Bicep, or ARM.
  • Azure DevOps Services: Deep familiarity with the full ADO suite (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts).
  • Scripting & Management: Proficiency with Azure CLI, PowerShell (Az module), and REST APIs.
  • Observability: Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Governance & Security: Strong grasp of Azure Policy, Blueprints, RBAC, and Azure Key Vault for secret/certificate management.
  • Containers & Serverless: Foundational knowledge of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Helm, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Functions, and App Services.

CI/CD & Deployment Strategies

  • Mastery of multi-stage YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps (GitHub Actions is a strong plus).
  • Proven track record implementing advanced deployment strategies (Blue-Green, Canary, Rolling).
  • Experience integrating security scanning tools such as SonarQube, WhiteSource, or Snyk into automated pipelines.

Security & Enterprise Compliance

  • Comprehensive understanding of Secure DevOps practices and automated security gates (SCA, IaC scans).
  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) integration and MFA policies.
  • Familiarity with Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and enterprise security baselines is highly desirable.

What Will Make You Successful

  • Technical Proficiency: You have a battle-tested understanding of enterprise Azure environments and CI/CD mechanics. You don't just use tools; you know how they work under the hood.
  • Creativity: You look beyond standard templates to find innovative ways to optimize workflows, solve complex deployment bottlenecks, and design elegant technical solutions.
  • Drive for Progress: You are self-motivated to push projects across the finish line while maintaining high-quality support standards.

title: Professor(a) de Artes Visuais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor(a) de Artes Visuais em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position: Visual Arts Teacher

Section: Early Childhood Education (ECE) and Elementary School

Application Deadline: June 12, 2026

Start Date: July 15, 2026


Main responsibilities: Plan, deliver, and develop Visual Arts lessons for Early Childhood and Elementary students, aligned with BNCC, the IB PYP framework, and the school’s pedagogical approach. Promote inquiry-based, creative, and student-centered learning experiences that foster curiosity, imagination, and artistic expression. Design developmentally appropriate learning experiences, exploring a variety of media and techniques such as drawing, painting, collage, and sculpture, encouraging exploration, experimentation, and the development of artistic skills. Support students’ holistic development by fostering cognitive, social, emotional, and creative competencies, while encouraging growing autonomy, reflection, and a sense of identity. Ensure a safe, inclusive, and welcoming learning environment that supports student well-being and confidence to take creative risks. Use formative and observational assessment strategies to monitor and document student progress. Differentiate instruction to meet diverse learning needs in collaboration with the learning support team. Actively contribute to the development of the Arts program through curriculum planning, interdisciplinary projects, exhibitions, and school events, while maintaining effective communication with families.


Requirements: Teaching degree (Licenciatura) in Visual Arts. Fluency in English (Portuguese is desirable). Teaching experience, preferably in bilingual or international settings. Ability to work effectively with students from diverse cultural backgrounds. Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Familiarity with educational technology tools and platforms. A Master's degree and IB PYP experience are considered desirable.


About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.


Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.


In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.


Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.


School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.


Cargo: Professor(a) de Artes Visuais

Segmento: Educação Infantil e Ensino Fundamental I

Prazo de Inscrição: 12 de junho de 2026

Data de início: 15 de julho de 2026


Principais responsabilidades: Planejar, ministrar e desenvolver aulas de Artes Visuais para estudantes da Educação Infantil e do Ensino Fundamental I, alinhadas à BNCC, ao PYP (IB) e ao projeto pedagógico da escola. Promover experiências de aprendizagem investigativas, criativas e centradas no aluno, que estimulem a curiosidade, a imaginação e a expressão artística. Elaborar experiências de aprendizagem adequadas ao desenvolvimento das crianças, explorando diferentes mídias e técnicas, como desenho, pintura, colagem, e escultura, incentivando a exploração, a experimentação e a construção de habilidades artísticas. Apoiar o desenvolvimento integral dos estudantes, promovendo competências cognitivas, sociais, emocionais e criativas, além de incentivar a autonomia progressiva, a reflexão e o senso de identidade. Garantir um ambiente seguro, inclusivo e acolhedor, que favoreça o bem-estar e a confiança dos alunos para assumir riscos criativos. Utilizar estratégias de avaliação formativa e observacional, com registro do progresso dos estudantes. Diferenciar o ensino para atender a diferentes perfis de aprendizagem em colaboração com a equipe de suporte à aprendizagem. Colaborar ativamente no desenvolvimento do programa de Artes, participando do planejamento curricular, projetos interdisciplinares, exposições e eventos escolares, além de manter comunicação eficaz com as famílias.


Requisitos: Licenciatura em Artes Visuais. Fluência em inglês (português desejável). Experiência docente, preferencialmente em contextos bilíngues ou internacionais. Capacidade de atuar de forma eficaz com estudantes de diferentes contextos culturais. Habilidades de comunicação, resolução de problemas e organização. Mestrado e experiência com o IB PYP serão diferenciais.


Sobre a empresa: A Escola das Nações é uma instituição internacional, privada, sem fins lucrativos, coeducacional e duolinguística (inglês e português), localizada em Brasília. Oferecemos um programa educacional que vai do berçário ao 12º ano e somos credenciados internacionalmente pela NEASC e, nacionalmente, pela Secretaria de Educação do Distrito Federal. Com estudantes e colaboradores de 30 países e origens diversas, promovemos um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo que incentiva a cidadania global e valoriza a diversidade.


Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.


Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.


A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.


A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

title: Consultor de Implantação | Setor Comercial

Oi, somos a WEBMANIA! Uma empresa de tecnologia que simplifica e automatiza processos fiscais para milhares de empresas no Brasil. Nosso sistema é responsável por processar milhões de documentos fiscais por ano para mais de 120 mil empresas, oferecendo inovação e eficiência para nossos clientes.


Buscamos um(a) Analista de Implantação Júnior | Pleno para ser alocado no setor comercial e trabalhar em um time descontraído, com uma cultura de extrema qualidade, entrega contínua e feedback rápido. Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Atuar de forma consultiva, esclarecendo dúvidas técnicas e promovendo a adoção e o total entendimento da plataforma;
  • Analisar processos e o cenário do cliente para elaborar propostas técnicas e sugerir o fluxo de uso mais eficiente da nossa solução;
  • Atuar como interface técnica entre o cliente e as equipes internas (Desenvolvimento, Financeiro e Suporte), traduzindo demandas para agilizar negociações e correções;
  • Identificar proativamente barreiras técnicas ou de usabilidade e buscar soluções rápidas para melhorar a experiência do usuário;


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando em Tecnologia, Sistemas de Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência anterior com implantação de sistemas (SaaS), onboarding de clientes ou suporte técnico B2B;
  • Boa capacidade analítica e facilidade para resolução de problemas;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal para conduzir apresentações e demonstrações online de forma clara e didática;

title: Project Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Consultant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

At Toluna, we keep the world’s biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we’ve been a leader in consumer insights, and today we’re at the center of our industry’s biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.


Brands come to us because we’ve solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we’ve been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries.


Introduction:

Responsible for managing Toluna's market research projects, the Project Consultant will be representing Toluna to our wide range of clients in the global market. The goal is to work on and coordinate projects from beginning to end under strict timelines, handling multiple projects simultaneously and interacting with Toluna’s internal operations teams while providing the best service to our clients. The Project Consultant will deliver a great client experience by meeting clients' strategic insights needs and will be supporting US-based clients while reporting to the North American-based client services team.


Responsibilities:

  • Provide exceptional client service while cultivating strategic, long-term partnerships
  • Advocate for clients’ needs to ensure alignment with project objectives and service standards
  • Demonstrate expertise in the Toluna Start platform and champion its use with clients
  • Independently manage full service, field & tab, and assisted-DIY research projects
  • Review and optimize questionnaire logic, providing recommendations to clients
  • Manage workload successfully by planning and prioritising all tasks and projects
  • Support clients and internal teams in achieving clients' research objectives
  • Liaise with other internal departments and external partners
  • Devise detailed internal and client project plans and ensure client needs are met and exceeded where possible
  • Check and compare actual project requirements against cost
  • Be the point of contact of our clients
  • Program surveys or work with internal programming team (according to agreed rules)
  • Ensure programming edits are implemented accurately, and survey test link is checked before sending to client
  • Manage overall project coordination, monitoring schedules, project margins, key deliverables, and client expectations
  • Update client on progress at regular intervals and provide regular fieldwork updates to the client
  • Perform data quality checks, including regular review and removal of poor-quality open-ended responses
  • Monitor fieldwork either fielded by you or fielded by the Field management team (according to agreed rules)


Your profile:

  • Experience: Minimum of 4 years in a project management role within market research, with expertise in managing complex projects
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced understanding of survey programming, questionnaire logic, and data metrics. Familiarity with programming platforms like Toluna Start, Confirmit, or related tools is essential
  • Project Management: Proven ability to independently manage multiple high-complexity projects while meeting tight deadlines
  • Artificial Intelligence: Proactive in adopting and leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, insight generation, and overall project performance
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to build client relationships and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Languages: Advanced English is mandatory; additional language skills are a plus.
  • Professional Traits: Proactive, adaptable, and self-motivated, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Approaches challenges with initiative, resourcefulness, and a positive drive to deliver results and can work independently while contributing effectively to team objectives.


Our Values:

A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability

B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial

C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness

D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly

E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, unlimited access to Udemy Business, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. If you’re passionate about making an impact on colleagues around the globe, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal voucher, transportation voucher TotalPass, and language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Service Representative em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Customer Service Representative

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.

Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.


The Role

This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.

You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
  • You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
  • You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
  • You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
  • You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You avoid dealing with difficult customers
  • You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
  • You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms


What You'll Do

Customer Support Execution

  • Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
  • Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
  • Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice

Social Media Support

  • Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency

Order & Refund Management

  • Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
  • Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed

Conflict Resolution

  • Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
  • Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
  • Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations


Requirements

Must have:

  • Experience in customer service (ecommerce or DTC preferred)
  • +1 years of experience using Shopify
  • Strong written communication skills in English
  • Experience handling social media interactions is a strong plus
  • High attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM.
  • Monthly salary: $3,000 - $4,000 USD
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business

Ready to Apply?

If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

description:

# SQLAlchemy, Python expert (remote, freelance)


## Company description


FairSplit.com , a small American company, helps families navigate estate, downsizing, death, or divorce by providing a web app for building inventories and then dividing assets among beneficiaries. FairSplit offers unique division methods such as Emotional Value rounds, promoting transparency, fairness and impartiality. This tool can be used by professionals assisting families or directly by family members.


Our motto is \"Divide things, not families\". The best thing about working for FairSplit is the certainty that we are making the world better, by helping people in rare, delicate moments of their lives .


## Role description


This is a **remote, freelance role for a senior backend Python developer**. You will work with other members of an agile team to write server-side logic and integrate front-end elements.


No agencies, please. Only individuals.


Payment is per hour worked. Hourly value dependent on your demonstrable experience. All work is remote.


This is a ~3-month-long position with a good chance of extending further.


## Technologies involved


- the Python language, with typing annotations

- SQLAlchemy (the Python ORM)

- the Starlette web framework (basis of FastAPI)

- the Pyramid web framework (legacy for us)

- git


## Requisites


- Fluent English.

- Committed to working 40h per week .

- Experience with back-end development and database design.

- Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.

- Deep knowledge about security and scalability of web apps.

- Interest in the themes of software architecture, open source and agile.

- Interest in pair programming.

- Attention to detail and precision in the use of language.

- Good communication: you don't disappear, you don't shun video calls, you are present in our Discord group while working, you ask for help when needed, you write on kanban cards to provide insight into your work and you spontaneously provide advice when you see the opportunity.

- Willing to sign an NDA.


Please share any public repositories (github etc.).

title: Senior SAP P2D Logistics Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior SAP P2D Logistics Consultant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior SAP P2D Logistics Consultant


About Us

Stefanini Latam Digital connects top LATAM talent with international digital transformation projects, helping enterprise clients scale through agile, nearshore technology solutions.


About the Role.

Stefanini Latam Digital is looking for a Senior SAP Plan-to-Deliver (P2D) Logistics Consultant to join a high-impact SAP S/4HANA transformation project in Brazil. This is a senior, hands-on opportunity for an SAP logistics expert with strong experience in SAP SD, Logistics Execution, delivery processes, transportation, warehouse integration, and manufacturing environments . The role is ideal for someone who can lead functional discussions, configure SAP logistics processes, work closely with business and IT stakeholders, and contribute to large-scale transformation initiatives.


Location: Brazil

Work Model: Hybrid — 3 days onsite per week

Employment Type: Full-time contractor

Compensation: Up to USD 6,200/month


What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement SAP S/4HANA logistics execution solutions.
  • Configure logistics execution processes in both SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA.
  • Define, optimize, and support outbound and inbound delivery processes.
  • Work on shipment, transportation planning, and logistics execution activities.
  • Ensure proper integration between SAP SD, MM, warehouse systems, and transportation platforms.
  • Lead workshops with logistics, supply chain, business, and IT stakeholders.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into functional SAP solutions.
  • Support testing, cutover, go-live, hypercare, and post-implementation activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery performance, logistics visibility, and operational efficiency.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and logistics KPI visibility when applicable.


What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience as an SAP Consultant, ideally at Senior Consultant, Lead, or Architect level.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP SD and SAP Logistics Execution .
  • Experience working with both SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA .
  • Solid knowledge of outbound deliveries, inbound deliveries, shipments, transportation planning, and logistics execution processes.
  • Experience integrating SAP with warehouse systems, SAP WM/EWM, WMS, or transportation platforms.
  • Previous experience in the manufacturing industry .
  • Participation in at least 1–2 full lifecycle SAP implementation projects.
  • Advanced or fluent English for business and technical communication.
  • Based in Brazil and available to work in a hybrid model, 3 days onsite per week.


Nice to Have

  • Automotive industry experience.
  • SAP TM experience.
  • SAP WM or SAP EWM experience.
  • Experience with logistics KPIs, transportation optimization, or S/4HANA analytics.
  • Experience in large-scale SAP transformation, rollout, or migration projects.


Why Join Us?

  • Join a large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation project.
  • Work with international teams and enterprise-level stakeholders.
  • Be part of a global technology organization with a strong LATAM presence.
  • Contribute to impactful logistics and supply chain transformation initiatives.
  • Receive monthly payments in USD through Deel.

title: Analista de Negócios (Jurídico e Tecnologia) - PJ
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Negócios (Jurídico e Tecnologia) - PJ em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida.

Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento.

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore; e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.


Descrição do Cargo

O Analista de Negócios (Jurídico e Tecnologia) - PJ será responsável por apoiar a transformação digital e a eficiência operacional do departamento jurídico, atuando como ponte entre os aspectos técnicos e jurídicos. Ele terá como missão implementar soluções tecnológicas, automatizar processos, gerir dados jurídicos e contribuir para a tomada de decisão estratégica baseada em métricas e indicadores.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de tecnologia no Jurídico: apoio na seleção, implantação e administração de softwares jurídicos (contratos, litígios, governança, gestão documental, workflow etc.).
  • Automação de processos: mapear fluxos internos, identificar gargalos e apoiar no desenvolvimento de soluções de automação (no-code/low-code, RPA ou integrações com sistemas da empresa).
  • Gestão de dados e analytics: apoio na estruturação de bases de dados jurídicas, extrair relatórios, criar dashboards e gerar insights para apoiar decisões.
  • Suporte em governança e compliance: assegurar que as ferramentas tecnológicas atendam requisitos de privacidade, segurança da informação e LGPD.
  • Gestão de fornecedores: atuar no relacionamento com lawtechs, escritórios de advocacia parceiros e prestadores de tecnologia.
  • Integração com outras áreas: trabalhar em conjunto com TI, compliance, financeiro e RH para integração de sistemas e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Formação Acadêmica Ideal: Graduação em áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Análise de Sistemas etc.).
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Legal Operations, Direito Digital, Gestão de Projetos, Compliance, Data Analytics ou Transformação Digital será diferencial.


O que buscamos:

Habilidades e Competências Técnicas

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão jurídica (Docusign CLM – Contract Lifecycle Management, e-law ERP jurídico, legal analytics, powerbi).
  • Noções de bancos de dados e BI (SQL, Power BI, Tableau).
  • Familiaridade com segurança da informação e LGPD.
  • Capacidade de dialogar tanto com advogados quanto com profissionais de TI.


Comportamentais

  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal para atuar como “tradutor” entre o jurídico e a TI.
  • Capacidade de gestão de projetos e priorização de demandas.
  • Mentalidade de inovação e melhoria contínua.

VENDEDOR EXTERNO (GESTOR DE NEGÓCIOS)


A Patrimonial Segurança é uma empresa especializada na proteção patrimonial, consolidada como referência no setor de segurança privada na região de Santa Catarina. Com uma trajetória marcada pela excelência e inovação, a empresa oferece soluções completas e personalizadas para atender às necessidades de segurança de seus clientes, sejam eles residenciais, comerciais ou industriais.

· Tecnologia Avançada: Utilizando equipamentos modernos, sistemas de monitoramento eletrônico, alarmes e controle de acesso, a empresa garante um alto nível de eficiência no combate a incidentes.

A empresa se destaca por sua ética profissional, compromisso com a qualidade e foco na construção de relacionamentos de confiança com seus clientes.

Com presença sólida na região de Chapecó e Itajaí, a Patrimonial Segurança é mais do que uma prestadora de serviços; é uma parceira estratégica na proteção de bens e na promoção da tranquilidade.

title: Executivo Comercial (Full-cycle)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo Comercial (Full-cycle) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A STORICA


The Creative Performance Company. Unimos estratégia, criativo, mídia, CRM, dados e consultoria para transformar marketing em crescimento previsível e mensurável.


Construímos sistemas de crescimento que conectam branding, performance e receita. Partimos de diagnóstico, definimos hipóteses, criamos, testamos, aprendemos e escalamos. É assim que entregamos crescimento sustentável para marcas reconhecidas, com cases premiados em performance.


Com base em Brasília e atuação em todo o Brasil, somos parceiros de marcas que querem converter atenção em valor real e presença em resultado. Se você quer fazer parte de um time que une visão estratégica, performance e criatividade para gerar impacto de negócio, aqui é o seu lugar.


VAGA: EXECUTIVO COMERCIAL (FULL-CYCLE)


Buscamos um Executivo Comercial para conduzir o ciclo de vendas da Storica de ponta a ponta. São vendas consultivas de média complexidade, que exigem entender o cenário do cliente, enquadrar a necessidade e desenhar o escopo do trabalho junto com ele. A posição é full-cycle: você domina todas as etapas, da qualificação ao fechamento, com autonomia para conduzir o relacionamento comercial e influenciar a forma como a Storica vende.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


• Qualificar as oportunidades com critério, reconhecendo o cliente certo para o método da Storica: empresas com maturidade e orçamento para investir de forma consistente em marketing digital.

• Conduzir diagnósticos consultivos para entender o estágio de maturidade em marketing de cada empresa e propor o caminho adequado entre as frentes da Storica: estratégia, criativo, mídia, CRM, dados e consultoria.

• Elaborar e apresentar propostas comerciais, com clareza de escopo, valor e objetivos de crescimento.

• Negociar e fechar contratos de forma sustentável, garantindo margem saudável e clientes alinhados ao perfil da agência.

• Gerenciar pipeline e previsibilidade de vendas em CRM, com cadência de follow-up, forecast e registro de oportunidades.

• Trabalhar próximo aos times de atendimento e estratégia para assegurar uma transição fluida entre venda e operação, preservando a clareza de expectativa e a qualidade do fit comercial.

• Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (oportunidades trabalhadas, taxa de conversão, receita nova, retenção de contratos) e reportar resultados periodicamente.


REQUISITOS ESSENCIAIS


• Experiência comprovada em venda consultiva B2B dentro do mercado de marketing digital, agência ou serviços de marketing. Requisito eliminatório, não diferencial. Procuramos quem já vendeu esse tipo de serviço e conhece o setor por dentro.

• Maturidade e repertório para conduzir uma reunião de fechamento com autonomia, enquadrar a necessidade do cliente e sustentar valor sem recorrer a preço.

• Capacidade de operar o ciclo completo de vendas com autonomia e total responsabilidade sobre o próprio funil.

• Domínio de negociação, diagnóstico e fechamento consultivo de contratos com recorrência mensal.

• Disciplina de pipeline e familiaridade com CRM (HubSpot, Kommo, RD Station, Pipedrive ou similar) e metodologias de funil (SPIN, BANT, GPCT).

• Comunicação verbal e escrita clara, com argumentação ancorada em dados e em valor.


Não buscamos vendedor de varejo nem consultor de vendas sem vivência no mercado de marketing. Também não é a posição certa para quem só rende com oportunidades entregues prontas por uma estrutura de pré-venda. Aqui você conduz o ciclo do início ao fim.


DESEJÁVEL


• Vivência com venda de serviços de marketing digital, growth ou branding com ticket recorrente.

• Conhecimento de métricas de performance (CAC, ROAS, CPA, LTV, margem) no nível de leitura executiva.

• Repertório no ciclo consultivo completo: qualificação, diagnóstico, proposta, fechamento e passagem para o onboarding.

• Boa compreensão de como marcas crescem a partir de dados, estratégia e execução integrada.


NOSSO TIME VAI GOSTAR SE VOCÊ…


• Entende que crescimento sustentável depende de qualidade de cliente, não de volume.

• Gosta de trabalhar com método e previsibilidade, medindo resultado e buscando evolução constante.

• É curioso e propositivo, não se limita a seguir script: questiona, sugere, melhora o processo.

• Se comunica com clareza, organiza o próprio pipeline e entrega o que promete.

• Enxerga o marketing como um sistema integrado de crescimento, e valoriza o equilíbrio entre performance e marca.


O QUE OFERECEMOS


• Estrutura sólida, com metodologia própria de crescimento e visão de longo prazo.

• Atuação com marcas relevantes de diferentes setores (educação, finanças, saúde, varejo, indústria).

• Cultura de autonomia, aprendizado e melhoria contínua.

• Distribuição de lucro uma vez por ano.

• Day-off no seu aniversário.

• Modelo híbrido, com base em Brasília.

• Contratação PJ, com fixo mais variável recorrente sobre os contratos fechados.


FAIXA DE REMUNERAÇÃO


• Fixo mensal de R$ 4.000.

• Variável recorrente sobre os contratos fechados.

• Ao atingir as metas projetadas, o ganho total mensal, somando fixo e variável, gira entre R$ 8.000 e R$ 12.000.

s.Mais do que cuidar da estrutura física, a área tem papel essencial na experiência e no acolhimento das pessoas, promovendo um ambiente mais humano, confortável e seguro.

  • Gerenciar os indicadores estabelecidos, através da orientação, capacitação e desenvolvimento de sua força de trabalho;

  • Assegurar a segurança dos colaboradores no desenvolvimento das tarefas;

title: Culture & Learning Senior Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Culture & Learning Senior Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


We're looking for a Culture & Learning Senior Manager to join our People & Organization team. In this role, you'll be a key driver of how we grow our people and shape the way we work together — building learning ecosystems and culture programs that scale with a fast-moving organization. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and knows how to turn ideas into programs that actually stick.


What You'll Do

  • Champion and evolve our organizational culture, ensuring it remains a competitive advantage as the company grows
  • Design and lead initiatives that reinforce our values in day-to-day work — from onboarding to team rituals and beyond
  • Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to embed cultural practices across all levels of the organization
  • Measure culture health and continuously iterate based on feedback and data
  • Build and manage end-to-end learning journeys for key talent segments (new hires, individual contributors, managers, leaders)
  • Identify capability gaps and design scalable programs — whether in-person, digital, or blended
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to HR Business Partners and senior leaders on people development topics
  • Manage budgets, timelines, and vendors with a results-oriented mindset
  • Build buy-in for culture and learning initiatives across a diverse, often distributed workforce


What We're Looking for

  • 10+ years of experience in L&D, organizational culture, or talent development
  • Proven track record in fast-paced, high-growth environments — internet, tech, or similarly dynamic industries strongly preferred
  • Experience designing and scaling learning programs from scratch, not just inheriting and maintaining
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills — you're as comfortable in a workshop as in a C-suite conversation
  • Data-driven mindset: you measure what matters and use it to improve
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate independently with minimal structure
  • Experience working across cultures or in multinational environments is a plus
  • Fluency in English required; additional languages


What Makes You Stand Out

  • You've built something from 0 to 1 — a program, a culture initiative, an L&D function
  • You understand that culture isn't a campaign — it's behavior, reinforce
  • You're energized by change, not slowed down by it.

title: SDR JR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SDR JR em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a WAS

A WAS é um estúdio criativo especializado em branding, audiovisual e social media. Não somos uma agência comum, somos parceiros estratégicos de marcas que entendem que comunicação de alto nível é um diferencial competitivo, não um custo.

Em três anos, construímos uma carteira sólida de clientes de diferentes segmentos com um denominador comum: todos querem crescer e sabem que imagem importa. A gente entrega isso com excelência, do conceito à execução.


Sobre a vaga

Não estamos procurando alguém que gosta de vendas. Estamos procurando alguém que é obcecado por prospecção.

Que sente prazer em ligar, em escrever, em abordar. Que não aceita silêncio como resposta. Que acorda pensando em como vai bater a meta da semana.

Você vai operar em três frentes simultâneas: leads inbound via tráfego pago, contatos de redes sociais e prospecção ativa de médias empresas. O objetivo é sempre o mesmo — reunião marcada com decisor.



Responsabilidades

· Construir e qualificar listas com ICP definido e segmentação inteligente

· Identificar e acessar decisores — C-level, lideranças de marketing, gerência

· Executar cadências multicanal: cold call, email e redes sociais com consistência

· Qualificar leads inbound e outbound e agendar reuniões para o time de especialistas

· Manter o CRM organizado e atualizado no Pipedrive sem lacunas

· Trabalhar metas semanais de volume e conversão

· Colaborar com o time de marketing para afinar abordagem e melhorar conversão



Requisitos

· Mínimo de 18 meses de experiência comprovada como SDR ou BDR

· Histórico real em prospecção outbound — ligações, listas, cadências

· Alta dominância: assertividade, foco em resultado e zero enrolação

· Alta influência: comunicação que persuade sem pressionar

· Energia, proatividade e resiliência que aparecem nos números, não só no discurso

· Boa escuta e raciocínio rápido para qualificar e contornar objeções na hora



Diferenciais

· Experiência em agência de marketing ou comunicação

· Conhecimento em branding, tráfego pago ou geração de leads

· Experiência com Pipedrive

· Vivência com vendas consultivas

· Domínio de ICP e funil de vendas



O que oferecemos

· Remuneração: R$2.500 fixo PJ + variável atrelado a metas de reuniões marcadas, sem teto

· Modelo 100% remoto

· Ambiente direto, sem burocracia, onde performance fala mais alto que tempo de casa



O requisito que não negocia

Obsessão por prospecção.

O resto a gente constrói junto.

  • Familiaridade com APIs REST, GraphQL e integrações complexas.
  • Vivência com GIT e Maven (para build e gerenciamento de dependências)


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :

  • Vivência em projetos de transformação digital e sistemas de grande escala.
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Assistência Médica

title: Senior .Net Engineer (WFH)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .Net Engineer (WFH) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer


Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: AWS Engineer (Security & Backend)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AWS Engineer (Security & Backend) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We have active HIPAA-related projects in flight — and we need an AWS engineer who can own the infrastructure and security layer. This is not a plug-and-play setup role. We need someone who thinks in systems, writes infrastructure as code, and understands that a misconfigured IAM policy in a healthcare context is not a learning opportunity — it's a liability. The backend work will be handled with AI-augmented development, so the right person will focus on architecture, security posture, and compliance — not boilerplate.

The Role
  • Design and implement HIPAA-compliant AWS infrastructure from the ground up (or audit/harden existing setups)
  • Configure IAM policies, VPCs, KMS encryption, and CloudTrail audit logging
  • Ensure PHI never touches a public subnet — and that the team understands why
  • Set up and manage audit logging pipelines (CloudTrail + CloudWatch + AWS Config)
  • Define and enforce encryption at rest and in transit across all relevant services
  • Write infrastructure as code using Terraform or AWS CDK
  • Work alongside our dev team and advise on security decisions throughout the project lifecycle
  • Potentially own backend development for net-new projects (scoped separately)
Requirements
  • AI Proficiency (Mainly in Claude.ai)
  • AWS Core
  • IAM — least-privilege policies, roles, SCPs, MFA enforcement
  • VPC — private/public subnet design, security groups, NACLs, VPC endpoints
  • KMS — encryption at rest (S3, RDS, EBS), key rotation, customer-managed keys
  • CloudTrail + CloudWatch + AWS Config — audit logging is a hard HIPAA requirement
  • Secrets Manager — zero hardcoded credentials, ever
  • RDS/Aurora or DynamoDB with encryption and automated backups
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • Terraform or AWS CDK — security config lives in code, not in console clicks
  • Security posture
  • GuardDuty, Security Hub, and ideally Prowler for compliance scanning
  • Solid understanding of which AWS services are HIPAA-eligible and which are not
  • Knows what a BAA is and why it matters before a single byte of PHI goes anywhere
  • Regulated environment experience
  • 3+ years hands-on AWS experience
  • Prior exposure to at least one regulated workload — HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or LGPD — is a strong plus
  • Comfortable working with a remote, async team

Nice to have

  • AWS Security Specialty or Solutions Architect Professional certification
  • Experience with Supabase or PostgreSQL in regulated contexts
  • Claude Certification

title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Go) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Together with the Zoolatech team, our partner, a leading construction management company, is at the forefront of developing a cloud-based software solution. This innovative platform is instrumental in the successful completion of major projects including skyscrapers, hospitals, data centers, stadiums, and schools. It streamlines the management of finances, quality, teams, and risks, making these processes transparent, convenient, and regulation-compliant. Our partner is not only an expert in construction management but also a significant technology innovator, actively developing web and mobile solutions.


Currently Directory business unit owns user identity and access management across their entire platform ecosystem. They've just launched a brand-new Go-based service into closed beta — a ground-up rebuild of how users and companies are managed across the platform. It's live, but not yet actively used. The work ahead is substantial: migrating data and business logic out of a Ruby monolith, building new features in parallel, and accelerating the service toward full production ownership. Now we are looking for reinforcement for the team to develop the new service and help with the migration from the legacy platform.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services in Go, implementing event-driven systems governed by CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Drive migration of business logic and data from the Ruby legacy monolith into the new Go service
  • Contribute to the new service while it moves from closed beta toward becoming authoritative — building ongoing features in parallel with migration
  • Develop and extend GraphQL Federation schemas that power the federated API gateway
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that address user and company management challenges
  • Use a systems engineering approach to make technical design decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Write highly performant code that supports a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Conduct code reviews, provide mentorship, and actively drive engineering excellence across the team
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Skills Required

  • 5+ years in Software Engineering across full-stack distributed applications
  • 3+ years of hands-on Go in production microservices
  • Experience with CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Experience with Kafka or similar distributed event streaming platforms
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, including schema design
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend contributions
  • Comfort working across the full development lifecycle: design, testing, staging, deployment, monitoring
  • Strong communication skills — ability to collaborate across US and international time zones
  • US time zone or compatible overlap (EST/CST);

Would be a huge plus:

  • Experience with Ruby/Rails systems, including incremental refactoring and modernization


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)


This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.


To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.


Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
